files.name: part_a.pdf
files.reference_text:
Part A: Database Design
Draw an ER diagram for the hostel booking system.
The schema must be in third normal form.
Submit the diagram as a PDF.
ER diagram 10
Normalisation 5
Total: 15 marks

files.name: part_b.docx
files.reference_text:
Part B: REST API
Implement endpoints to create, list and cancel bookings.
Every endpoint must return JSON and proper HTTP status codes.
Protect the endpoints with token authentication.
Use the schema from Part A.
Endpoints 15
Authentication 5
Total: 20 marks

files.name: part_c.md
files.reference_text:
Part C: Testing
Write integration tests for every endpoint of Part B.
Tests should run in the CI pipeline.
Submit the test report as a PDF.
Integration tests 10
CI pipeline 5
Total: 15 marks
